cases.scenario: Review a substantial Python change with reachable callers and tests.
must: inspect behavior and callers before findings under §A-EVAL-01
mustNot: invent code not present in the candidate

cases.scenario: The task is trivial or contains no Python change.
must: state that the specialist review is not applicable under §A-EVAL-01

cases.scenario: Repository evidence or required Python tooling is missing.
must: separate unknown evidence from a clean verdict under §A-EVAL-01
